test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Ability to see what might happen in the future
solution:
The correct answer is** "Foresight".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Foresight** means the ability to see what might happen in the future.
 
• **Synonyms -** Foreknowledge, prescience.
 
• **Example **- *His career choice shows a lack of foresight*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hindsight **- The understanding that you have of a situation only after it has happened.

 
 
• **Example -** *With hindsight, we clearly see the alternatives.*
 
 
 
• **Prospect -** The possibility that something will happen.
 
 
• **Example -*** There's little prospect of better weather by next week.*
 
 
 
• **Provision -** The giving of something to somebody 
 
 
• **Example - ***The government is responsible for the provision of education.*
